pgx_rules:
# Research/education interpretations. These data never prescribe a dose.
version = 1
source = "CPIC-style pharmacogenetic phenotype rules; verify current clinical guidance"

[[genes]]
gene = "CYP2C19"
markers = ["rs4244285", "rs4986893", "rs12248560"]
intermediate_text = "CYP2C19 intermediate metabolizer"
consult = "Show this to your doctor or pharmacist; do not change any medicine on your own."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4244285:A=0 and rs4986893:A=0 and rs12248560:T=0"
text = "CYP2C19 normal metabolizer"
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4244285:A=0 and rs4986893:A=0 and rs12248560:T=1"
text = "CYP2C19 rapid metabolizer"
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4244285:A=0 and rs4986893:A=0 and rs12248560:T>=2"
text = "CYP2C19 ultrarapid metabolizer"
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4244285:A=1 and rs4986893:A=1"
text = "CYP2C19 poor metabolizer"
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4244285:A>=2"
text = "CYP2C19 poor metabolizer"
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4986893:A>=2"
text = "CYP2C19 poor metabolizer"
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4244285:A>0"
text = "CYP2C19 intermediate metabolizer"
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4986893:A>0"
text = "CYP2C19 intermediate metabolizer"

[[genes]]
gene = "CYP2C9/VKORC1"
markers = ["rs1799853", "rs1057910", "rs9923231"]
consult = "Show this to your doctor or pharmacist; do not change any medicine on your own."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "any_alt"
text = "The genotype affects warfarin treatment; the prescriber uses an official dosing table."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "default"
text = "No warfarin-associated alleles in this small panel; this alone does not establish a treatment plan."

[[genes]]
gene = "SLCO1B1"
markers = ["rs4149056"]
consult = "Show this to your doctor or pharmacist; do not change any medicine on your own."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs4149056:T>0"
text = "Higher simvastatin muscle side-effect risk."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "default"
text = "The checked simvastatin-associated allele was not found; other risk factors remain."

[[genes]]
gene = "DPYD"
markers = ["rs3918290"]
consult = "Show this to your doctor or pharmacist; do not change any medicine on your own."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs3918290:A>0"
text = "Reduced DPD and high fluorouracil toxicity risk; confirm before treatment."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "default"
text = "DPYD *2A was not found in this panel; this does not exclude other reduced-function alleles."

[[genes]]
gene = "TPMT/NUDT15"
markers = ["rs1142345", "rs116855232"]
consult = "Show this to your doctor or pharmacist; do not change any medicine on your own."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "any_alt"
text = "Thiopurine toxicity risk associated with the checked TPMT/NUDT15 allele."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "default"
text = "The checked thiopurine-associated alleles were not found; other risk alleles are not excluded."

[[genes]]
gene = "CYP3A5"
markers = ["rs776746"]
consult = "Show this to your doctor or pharmacist; do not change any medicine on your own."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs776746:T>0"
text = "CYP3A5 *1 carrier: tacrolimus requirements may differ; the prescriber interprets this."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "default"
text = "No CYP3A5 *1 allele was called at this marker; this small panel does not define all metabolism."

[[genes]]
gene = "HCP5"
markers = ["rs2395029"]
consult = "Show this to your doctor or pharmacist; do not change any medicine on your own."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "rs2395029:G>0"
text = "Possible HLA-B*57:01 tag. Confirm with an HLA test before abacavir; this tag is imperfect."
[[genes.rules]]
when = "default"
text = "The HCP5 tag allele was not found; this is not a full HLA test."
